title: EXPLORE MICROSOFT
description: A paid 12-week summer internship built for first- and second-year students. You join a small pod of interns and build real software alongside Microsoft engineers.

title: UBER CAREER PREP
description: A free virtual program that gets CS undergrads internship-ready through workshops, mock interviews, and 1:1 mentoring with an Uber engineer.

title: SEO TECH DEVELOPER
description: Free program for CS freshmen and sophomores that pairs technical training and mentorship with a paid summer residency (about $6,000).

title: CODE2040 FELLOWS
description: A 10-month career accelerator for Black and Latinx students in tech. Fellows get mentorship, technical training, and help landing a paid summer internship.

title: KP ENGINEERING FELLOWS
description: Spend a paid summer as an engineer at a Kleiner Perkins portfolio startup, plus founder talks and a 1,000+ alumni network.

title: NEO SCHOLARS
description: Connects top CS undergrads at US schools with leading founders and engineers for mentorship, a tight-knit peer community, and fast-tracked startup recruiting.

title: SUMMER OF BITCOIN
description: A remote summer program open to university students worldwide. Contribute to Bitcoin open-source projects with a mentor and get paid a stipend in bitcoin.

title: DAAD RISE GERMANY
description: Funded summer research internships at German universities and institutes for undergrads from North America, the UK and Ireland. Most roles don't require German.

title: MITACS GLOBALINK
description: Spend 12 weeks doing research at a Canadian university under a faculty supervisor. Open to undergrads from Mitacs partner countries.

title: CERN OPENLAB
description: A paid 9-week summer at CERN in Switzerland for bachelor's and master's computing students, working on ML, data, and high-performance computing.

title: NSF REU
description: Paid summer research at US universities for undergrads, often with stipend, housing, and travel covered. Hundreds of sites, many in computer science.

title: JANE STREET INSIGHT
description: A free multi-day program at Jane Street covering trading, software engineering, and strategy. Travel and housing are covered, and no finance background is needed.

title: CODEPATH
description: A nonprofit running free virtual CS courses for college students, including a 10-week Technical Interview Prep course taught with engineers from top tech companies.

title: COLORSTACK
description: A free community for Black and Latinx CS students in the US and Canada, offering career fairs, interview prep, mentorship, and internship access.

title: REWRITING THE CODE
description: A free global community for women in tech. Its 12-month fellowship offers coaching, networking, and internship opportunities with partner companies.
